mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.75% over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing boosts risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines below 0.75% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market repricing of risk.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% and increase in housing starts above 1700 thousand units signals robust labor market conditions and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1700.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 growth rate exceeding 2.5% annually), the S&P 500 produces negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to valuation compression from impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1700 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as demand expansion supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1700.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage pressures and inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate risk-off market reactions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production below 105.0 and rise in federal funds rate above 0.75% signals economic slowdown coupled with monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.75.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% year-over-year), aggressive central bank rate hikes cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5.
